section.title: External command hooks
section.subtitle: Run your own scripts around model actions (codex event names kept)
field.enabled.label: Enable lifecycle hooks
field.enabled.help: When off, no hook runs at all (the config file stays, so you can turn it back on anytime).
field.configPath.label: Hook config file
field.configPath.help: codex-shaped JSON: `{ "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [{ "matcher": "bash", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "node guard.js", "timeout": 5 }] }] } }`. timeout is in seconds.
field.timeoutMs.label: Default hook timeout (ms)
field.timeoutMs.help: What a hook gets when it does not set timeout itself. Range {min}–{max} ms.
field.failClosed.label: A hook that did not run blocks
field.failClosed.help: Off by default, same as codex: a hook blocks the action only when it exits with code 2 (and writes the reason to stderr); timeouts, failures to start and other non-zero exits just leave a notice. Turn this on and those cases block too — one small bug in a script then kills the whole round of tool calls, so only enable it once you trust the hooks.
field.commandAllowlist.label: Command allowlist
field.commandAllowlist.placeholder: Empty = no restriction; for example node, uv
field.commandAllowlist.help: When set, only hooks whose entry command is on the list run, compared on the first word (`node` lets `node guard.js` through but not `nodejs-evil`). A blocked hook counts as one that did not run; whether that blocks is up to the switch above.
field.capabilities.label: Wiring status of the fourteen events ({unwired} not wired)
field.capabilities.help: For events marked “not wired” Pneuma has no extension point to attach to, so a configured hook never runs; the reason is in the entry below.
field.loaded.label: Loaded hooks
field.loaded.empty: (no hooks in the config file yet)
field.problems.label: Parts not wired or not in effect
field.problems.help: Broken entries were skipped; the other hooks still work.
field.file.label: Config file
save.pathEmpty: The hook config path cannot be empty.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
